verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows generic Marketing API capabilities (create contacts, send campaigns) and mentions 'Predictive Segmentation' as a paid feature, but there is no documentation of an API endpoint or agent-facing surface that translates a plain-language audience description into a concrete segment. Missing for 10: any segment-creation API reference, any NL-to-criteria translation mechanism, and any example of an agent invoking this programmatically.
